items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: In the same band that Dart Skinner, Ned Skinner's son... and -- let's see, they had a tenor player

ctx.x: In the same band that Dart Skinner, Ned Skinner's son, the one that played the high notes, and -- let's see, they had a tenor

player, I think. They called him "Big Stack." I never knew his real name. And a couple of other fellows. I know their name, but I can't call them. I'm having a mental block. I can see them, but I can't call it.
